title: Print Your Name
description: Write a program that prints `My name is VidyaQuest Coder` to the console, with a comment above your print statement.
instructions: Output the exact greeting line: My name is VidyaQuest Coder
Add a comment above your print statement explaining what the line does.
constraints: Output must match: My name is VidyaQuest Coder
hints: Comments start with # in Python and // in JavaScript and Java.
Print the exact string "My name is VidyaQuest Coder".
Ensure there are no extra spaces at the start or end of the string.
